To: Barbara Blair
Cc: Richard Henderson, Kelly Snyder

Good, that gives us what we need to move. Once Richard Henderson has the descriptions and the priority list, he and Kelly Snyder will scope the searches to the features you have flagged, and the reading follows from there.

I will not send you a view on risk until the searching behind it is done, so you are not working from a half-formed answer on anything {{fact:f:E-2020-001.client}} has to decide. When we have enough to say something useful, you will have it in writing and we can talk it through.
